YSRCP protests Andhra Pradesh over teacher recruitment exam allegations

The YSRCP has organized protests across Andhra Pradesh concerning alleged irregularities in the DSC-2025 teacher recruitment exam. Protesters are demanding the resignation of Education Minister Nara Lokesh and a CBI probe into the matter. Several centrist and right-leaning outlets reported on these protests and demands. Separately, reports also covered a paper leak in Odisha's PG medical exam and protests by Delhi BJP against AAP over alleged Punjab paper leaks.
